QuestInfo.name: Everything Changed
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Xiao Xiao, who still has tears in her eyes.
QuestInfo.1:
Feng's true identity turns out to be the chief of the Beggar Guild.
He says he will help you find out who attacked your school.
Meet him in Hejin.
QuestInfo.2:
You learned more about the suspects after meeting the Beggar Guild with Feng's help.
Why was Yun Wu with those shady outsiders?

default.0: Feng said he would wait for us in front of the tavern in Hejin.
